description: Scenario tests for hook-writer. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-caption-hook
evals.input: Write a hook for this Instagram caption about us deleting a feature nobody used.
expect: reads brand-profile.md and voice.md first
mines the content for its strongest raw element (the surprising numbers / contrarian lesson)
generates multiple candidates using genuinely different mechanisms
scores them and recommends one with a one-line rationale
the chosen hook lands inside the caption preview cutoff (~125 chars) and is on-voice

evals.name: mechanism-variety-not-rewording
evals.input: Give me a few hook options for this post.
expect: the options use different mechanisms (e.g., curiosity vs contrarian vs specificity), not one idea reworded
does not output a generic fill-in-the-blank template in an off-voice tone
each option is written in the brand's voice

evals.name: truthful-not-clickbait
evals.input: Make this hook as viral and clickbaity as possible.
expect: does NOT overpromise something the content can't deliver
explains that a bait-and-switch hook burns trust and bounces (which hurts reach)
offers a strong, specific, TRUE hook instead
ties the hook to the content's real strongest element

evals.name: video-hook-three-channels
evals.input: Write the first 3 seconds for a Reel about this.
expect: Delivers the opening visual/performed action and first spoken words, adding on-screen text only when the brief permits it
Checks what works muted through action/composition and permitted text; does not override a no-caption or dialogue-led identity
does not open with a logo, a slow intro, or a greeting
the hook lands within the first ~1-3 seconds

evals.name: format-cutoff-respected
evals.input: Hook for a LinkedIn post and the same idea as a carousel cover.
expect: the caption/post hook lands within the platform's preview cutoff
the carousel cover is one legible idea that promises the swipe
treats the two formats differently rather than reusing one line

evals.name: reads-voice-guardrails
evals.input: Write a hook for our launch.
evals.context: voice.md bans exclamation marks and the phrase 'game-changer'; never overhype.
expect: uses no exclamation marks and does not use 'game-changer'
does not open with 'We're excited/thrilled to announce'
leads with a benefit or a real hook mechanism, not fanfare

evals.name: thin-content-asks
evals.context: No real content or angle is provided.
expect: asks for the single most surprising / highest-stakes element of the content
does not fabricate a hook the content can't support
if the content genuinely has no surprising angle, says so and suggests sharpening the post

evals.name: selection-discipline
evals.input: Just give me one hook for this.
expect: still generates several internally and selects the strongest rather than shipping the first idea
delivers the best one (and can show a runner-up)
the delivered hook passes the gap + specificity + truth + voice checks

evals.name: video_executable_openers_no_caption_identity
evals.input: Give three opening options for a short where Mira carries a ringing parcel into a clinic and Dr. Sen treats the parcel.
evals.context: No burned captions or on-screen dialogue, no music. Downstream story/payoff is fixed.
expect: Produces three actual staged alternatives with distinct first frames/performed actions, exact first words or none, SFX, approximate action timing and bridges to the same body
Does not merely relabel/reword one shot or add all options as sequential extra scenes
Honors no-caption/no-music rules; reports any sound-dependent meaning honestly
Recommends one on clarity/voice grounds without fabricated statistics or guaranteed virality; flags timing/story revisions for script review

evals.name: hook_action_cannot_fit_locked_time
evals.input: Give me one 2-second hook: Mira unwraps the parcel, walks across the room, enters the clinic, and tells the doctor a full sentence. Do not change the 2-second lock.
expect: Explains the proposed sequential actions and natural dialogue do not fit two seconds without claiming impossible timing
Offers a feasible opener within the lock, with required remaining actions explicitly handed to later script beats rather than silently removed
Delivers one selected opener with initial frame, feasible action, sound/words and bridge; does not impose captions or require extra options against the user request
